gloss: to blow violently; to rage; to sweep through

definitions.gloss: to blow violently; to rage (of wind or storm)
definitions.explanation: describes wind, storms, or blizzards blowing with great force and intensity
used figuratively for social phenomena, trends, or turmoil spreading or intensifying dramatically

examples.japanese: {台風|たいふう}が{吹|ふ}き{荒|あ}れている。
{吹雪|ふぶき}が{一晩中|ひとばんじゅう}{吹|ふ}き{荒|あ}れた。
examples.english: The blizzard raged all night long.

examples.japanese: {強風|きょうふう}が{吹|ふ}き{荒|あ}れて{外|そと}に{出|で}られない。
examples.english: The strong wind is blowing so violently that I can't go outside.

examples.japanese: リストラの{嵐|あらし}が{吹|ふ}き{荒|あ}れた。
examples.english: A wave of layoffs swept through.

examples.japanese: {批判|ひはん}の{嵐|あらし}が{吹|ふ}き{荒|あ}れている。
examples.english: A storm of criticism is raging.

examples.japanese: {不況|ふきょう}が{吹|ふ}き{荒|あ}れる{中|なか}、{会社|かいしゃ}は{生|い}き{残|のこ}った。
examples.english: The company survived amid the raging recession.

notes:
FORMATION:
{吹|ふ}く (to blow) + {荒|あ}れる (to become rough/wild) → to blow wildly

CONJUGATION:
Ichidan verb ({一段動詞|いちだんどうし})
- {吹|ふ}き{荒|あ}れる → {吹|ふ}き{荒|あ}れない → {吹|ふ}き{荒|あ}れて → {吹|ふ}き{荒|あ}れた

TRANSITIVITY:
Intransitive verb ({自動詞|じどうし})

COMMON SUBJECTS:
- {風|かぜ}/{強風|きょうふう} (wind/strong wind)
- {台風|たいふう} (typhoon)
- {吹雪|ふぶき} (blizzard)
- {嵐|あらし} (storm)
- ～の{嵐|あらし} (storm of ~) - figurative

FIGURATIVE USAGE:
The {嵐|あらし} metaphor is commonly combined with this verb for social/economic phenomena:
- リストラの{嵐|あらし} (wave of restructuring/layoffs)
- {批判|ひはん}の{嵐|あらし} (storm of criticism)
- {不況|ふきょう}の{嵐|あらし} (storm of recession)
